items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 21:1
items.html: The first nine Sefirot that fell away from all the Partzufim of the soul of Adam HaRishon are called Zihara Ila’a [upper radiance]. (p. 682, Item 91)
